Six people, John, Kelash, Lalit, Mohan, Niresh and Sapna, are sitting in a straight row, facing the north. No one sits to the right of Mohan. Only three people sit between Mohan and Kelash. Niresh is an immediate neighbour of both Sapna and Mohan. Lalit sits to the immediate right of Kelash. Who sits to the immediate right of John?

Each of E, F, G, H, K, L and M has an exam on a different day of a week, starting from Monday and ending on Sunday of the same week. No one has an exam before E. Only three people have exams between E and M. Only one person has an exam between M and K. G has an exam on Wednesday. H has an exam on one of the days after F but on one of the days before L. On which day of the week does H have an exam?

Given below is a statement followed by two possible reasons numbered I and II. Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explain(s) the event/observation/information given in the statement.Statement:Despite having a renowned faculty, University Z has witnessed a decline in student enrollment.Reasons:I. The university is located in a remote area with limited accessibility.II. A neighbouring university offers similar courses at a lower tuition cost.
options: Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
Both I and II are possible reasons.
Only I is a possible reason.
questions.explanation: सही उत्तर विकल्प 'C' (Both I and II are possible reasons.) है।

Read the statement carefully and decide which of the two reasons explains the event/observation/information given in the statement. Statement:Despite having a large number of skilled graduates, Country A faces a shortage of skilled workforce in the technology sector.Reasons:I. Many skilled graduates from Country A migrate to other countries for better career opportunities and higher salaries.II. The technology sector in Country A faces challenges such as outdated infrastructure and limited investment in research and development.
options: Both I and II are possible reasons.
Only I is a possible reason.
Neither I nor II is a possible reason.
Only II is a possible reason.
